RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of discrimination, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate bias. Department head positions prioritize commercial acumen, leadership, and client development over pure technical tenure; both candidates were fully qualified chartered engineers. 

Raising the panel's demographics without concrete proof of bias or procedural misconduct will damage your professional reputation and industry relationships while carrying virtually no legal traction. Furthermore, two weeks is a standard turnaround time for corporate feedback. 

Rather than alleging bias, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback on your interviews to identify areas to highlight or develop for future leadership opportunities.
